results.segment: A vehicle registered to you was recorded at Cunningham Gateway on 11 June 2026 at 10.40am without a valid ticket or permit. This is a Parking Charge Notice, reference ZK719022.
The charge is £63.74. If you pay within 28 days the amount is reduced to £38.24.
If you believe the notice was issued in error you may appeal in writing to the address above, quoting the reference. An appeal received after 13 July 2026 will not be considered.
Photographs taken at the time are held on file and can be requested.

This notice is issued under Schedule 4 of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012. If the driver is not identified within the period stated, the registered keeper may become liable. If your appeal to us is unsuccessful you will be given a code to take it to the independent appeals service.
